text:
rina: Opening a short thread for the relnotes + examples sweep before the 0.10.0 docs push. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4419. Items: changelog bullets for routing defaults, small known-issues, SDK snippet parity, and a link-fix pass.

oliver: I'll take SDK parity. Quick Q: do we prefer showing both stable and alpha JS clients when examples differ, or only stable?

rina: Show both for now with a one-line note about client version. Keeps rollback easier for readers.

sam: Found two broken anchors in the draft site preview: `/guides/kv-cache#overview` -> should be `/reference/kv-cache` and `/docs/embeds#streaming` -> `/reference/embeddings#migration`. I'll add redirects in the PR branch.

tori: Small wording tweak for the routing blurb: emphasize "opt-in" and that customers can configure policy per-route. Proposed sentence: "Hosted default now prefers latency; set per-route `routing_policy` to opt back into cost-first behavior."

rina: Good wording. @oliver can you add JS + Rust snippets and mark them with client-version notes? @sam please push the redirects. Target to merge after CI + preview check by EOD.

docs-bot: link-checker: 2 broken anchors detected, 0 external warnings. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4419--docs.redwood.ai/

oliver: Pushed JS snippets (stable + alpha notes) and Rust examples. Marked JS as done in the PR.

sam: Redirects and tiny netlify config fix pushed. Ran link-check locally; preview now reports zero broken anchors.

tori: Quick visual QA on preview looks fine. No layout issues.

rina: Thanks all, merging once CI finishes. Will post a short announce blurb after publishing.
